layout_decisions: Item description12/16 are two physical display-line slots of one compiled UI paragraph. Reflow the complete joined meaning into those two slots, retaining typed record order and all numeric/gameplay fields. No dialogue record or voice boundary is changed.

Preserve all printf placeholders, caret coordinates and colour tokens. UI labels may use explicit abbreviations: Mental=Mental Strength, S/L/P=Short Range/Long Range/Piercing, Long/Short/Pierce are range captions.
Finish? remains a generic confirmation, not a quit/end-battle claim. The caller copies27bytes; keep this payload aligned and zero-padded to27bytes.

Native item/unit selection font is13x26; planned26x26 and400px selector window allows all current complete short labels (maximum383px before final name corrections), without changing selection IDs or command flow.

Two additional shared caption values, Support/Cannon, supply the native EN-entry heading and formatted prompts through the existing three-entry pointer table. Existing795 English is unchanged;804 reviews only these dependencies.
